integrity: Analytic proof for arbitrary countable mixtures; exact-rational standalone script checks a three-size sharpness case and samples finite mixtures only. No external or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic well-mixed two-strategy replicator system; fixed strategy-independent mixture of geometric-return games with common cost and specified convergence. Not a result about adaptive participation, finite stochastic populations or network-structured hypergraphs. Two-order and common-multiplier random-size cases have important prior coverage; unindexed equivalents are possible.
title: A universal two-equilibrium ceiling for heterogeneous nonlinear public-goods mixtures
